# Gym 2.0

> Gym 2.0 is a free, open source workout tracker for iPhone and the web. It logs your sets, shows on a body map which muscles you trained, suggests workouts for the muscles you haven't trained this week and lets you train with friends. No ads, no tracking, hosted in Switzerland.

- Web app: https://gym2.app (also installable on Android from the browser)
- iPhone app (iOS 17 or later): https://apps.apple.com/app/id6695759065
- Price: free, an account is needed to use the app

## Features

- Log every set: reps, weight, time, intensity and distance, one side at a time for unilateral exercises, with a stopwatch and the history of every exercise
- See your muscles: a body map of what you trained in the last days and what you skipped
- Suggested workouts: picks exercises for the time and equipment you have
- Stats and records: personal records, volume and the distribution over your muscle groups
- Train with friends: chats, groups and Gym-AI, an assistant for ideas for your next session
- Works offline: everything is stored on the device first and synced between the iPhone and the web app

## Privacy

- No analytics, no third-party SDKs, data is never sold or used to train AI models
- The server, the database and Gym-AI run in Switzerland, data can be downloaded or deleted anytime
